nom: TULA 24-7 Power Swipe Hydrating Day & Night Treatment Eye Balm

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who say most eye products trigger an allergic reaction for them, report this balm is soothing and non-irritating; the exception is one reviewer who found her eyes watered and itched from the very first application, likely reacting to one of the extracts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with chronically dry, flaky under-eyes report the balm resolved the problem, some saying they have not had dry or flaky skin there in months or years of continued use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 60s mostly report a visible difference and make it a staple of their routine; the exception is a 57-year-old reviewer who noticed no real change under her eyes and found the stick migrated onto her contact lenses.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly smoother or fewer fine lines, in some cases within days, including one in her early 30s who says lines that developed over a few years were gone after four months of use; dissent includes one reviewer who felt it did nothing for her fine lines after a month and a couple who say it is too soon to tell.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the balm as strongly hydrating for the under-eye area, some saying it resolved years of chronic dryness or flaking; one reviewer dissents, saying it never really moisturized her under-eye area and left it dried out instead.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her eyes became red, burning, and watery over the course of the day, though she found it fine to use only at bedtime; by contrast, another with sensitive skin finds it soothing when irritation is starting.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the balm contains an undisclosed exfoliating acid that thinned the already-delicate skin around her eyes with twice-daily use as directed; no other reviewer reports a similar barrier concern.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visibly brighter or less noticeable dark circles, some within a single week; a consistent minority, however, report no change in their dark circles despite weeks of use, and one adds that it gave her headaches with no visible benefit.
concerns.blemishes: The couple of reviewers who mention breakouts report the balm does not clog pores or cause new blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Balm can fall out of the tube
Firm stick can tug or drag on delicate skin
Convenient, mess-free stick format, good for travel
Small size, runs out quickly for the price
Doubles as a subtle dewy highlighter

extraits.texte: This product contains lactic acid. It is not listed in the details or instructions that this product exfoliates! I noticed it was extoliating the skin around my eyes, so I had to checked the actual ingredint list, and then seen the lactic acid. It made the skin ariund my eyes thinner and I was follwing the instructuons that claimed you can use it safely twice a day. Who wants to exfoliate the delicate and thin skin around their eyes? Not me. I would sue this company if I could. People need to be warned and notified when putting products that exfoliate anywhere on thier face, especially on the eye and neck area since those areas have the thinnest skin on the entire body. Almost everything in the entire Tula brand exfoliates. How much skin does the lady who created this brand think that we have? She must have the thickest skin in the world, if she can handle using all of this stuff on her face every single day.

I suppose if hydration is the only goal that you have then this stick might be for you but I fell for the hype and paid for what to me is essentially eye chapstick. I've heard others say that they stopped using under eye concealer because of this product and that has definitely not been the case for me. I don't feel that this does anything for my eye area other than moisturize it, there is no effect on my dark circles or fine lines.

I honestly love how this feels applying this under eyes . It's a he's clean swipe that absorbs instantly It looks nice, it does, But, I noticed as the day went on, my eyes were burning and watering and red . Not an eye I'll use before going out. But at bedtime! Yes:)

I bought this for the high amount of squalane and the caffeine. Unfortunately, I must be sensitive to one of the extracts because my eyes water the minute I put it on. also it itched a bit the first time. I only applied to my orbital bone with my finger. I guess it's just not for me :(

Bought few months back ran out and I could tell a difference even at my age (69) I'm not trying to look 40 yrs younger but when my eyes seeing a difference once I ran out of product I knew I had to continue. Not to mention how easy the application is too.

This product was life changing for me!! I just turned 30 and noticed myself developing fine lines under my eyes within the past few years. Never in a million years did I think this product would reverse that…I just got it mainly for hydration. But sure enough - 4 months later and my lines are GONE!!! I also have really sensitive skin and most eye products give me an allergic reaction but this one did not and is in fact soothing when I feel a little under eye skin irritation coming on. I hope Tula always keeps this product in their arsenal because I am now a lifetime customer!!!
My under eyes are extremely dry and flake very easily. I have been using this product for almost 2 year and I have not had dry or flaky under eyes since.
